findings.evidence: isAdmin returns true if req.headers['x-admin']==='yes', letting any unauthenticated caller claim admin, violating only-authenticated-admins; req.user role branch only helps if req.user is set by trusted auth.

webhookOk compares only signature.startsWith(expected.slice(0,8)) (first 4 bytes of HMAC-SHA256) with non-constant-time startsWith instead of full-length timing-safe equality, so signatures are not fully verified.
invoiceQuery concatenates tenantId and invoiceId into a SQL string instead of parameterized/bound parameters, enabling SQL injection and tenant-isolation break.
overLimit uses requestCount > 6 so overLimit(6) is false and the sixth request in a window is not blocked; requirement is to block the sixth, i.e. requestCount >= 6.
